ms.title: Kenaikan gaji bukan sekadar menukar satu angka
ms.excerpt: Jika gaji minimum dinaikkan, beri PMKS tempoh peralihan 6–12 bulan, kaji impak dahulu dan semak KWSP 2% pekerja asing.

en.title: A wage rise isn’t just changing one number
en.excerpt: If the minimum wage rises, give MSMEs a 6–12 month transition, assess the impact first and review the 2% foreign-worker EPF.

zh.title: 加薪不能只调一个数字
zh.excerpt: 若调高最低薪金，应给微中小企 6 至 12 个月过渡期，先做影响评估，并检讨外劳 2% 公积金。
